correctness.rationale: For ordered Bell-diagonal correlation magnitudes \(s_1\ge s_2\ge s_3\), positivity at fixed \(q=s_1+s_2+s_3\in[1,3]\) reduces exactly to \(s_1+s_2-s_3\le1\). Writing \(y=s_2\), \(z=s_3\) gives the exact feasible polygon \((q-1)/2\le z\le q/3\), \(z\le y\le(q-z)/2\). The normalized discord \(D_G=(y^2+z^2)/3\) is then minimized and maximized analytically, producing the stated sharp families and crossover. Continuity on the connected feasible set proves that every intermediate value is attained. Exact-rational enumeration is supplementary only.

value.rationale: The result gives a sharp operational tradeoff for a canonical exactly solvable family: at a prescribed useful teleportation performance it identifies the minimum and maximum normalized geometric discord, proves all intermediate values attainable, classifies extremizers, and locates a nontrivial change of the upper-optimal family at \(F=9/13\). This is more informative than a one-sided inequality or a single Werner-line example and directly answers which Bell-diagonal resources are compatible with a target teleportation fidelity.
